department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: TOEFL 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale, with section minimums.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL 4.5 (writing 4.5, speaking 4, reading 4, listening 4), IELTS 6.5 (writing 6.0, speaking 6.0)

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in writing and speaking.
ielts_min.quote: TOEFL 4.5 (writing 4.5, speaking 4, reading 4, listening 4), IELTS 6.5 (writing 6.0, speaking 6.0)

supervisor.value: You need a faculty supervisor who endorses your admission before an offer is made.
supervisor.quote: A supervisor is required to receive an offer of admission. | At the time of admission, each student must have a faculty supervisor who has endorsed the recommendation for admission.

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student, international included, gets at least CAD 29,145 a year for four years; internationals also get an award covering the international tuition difference.
funding.quote: Full-time doctoral students (both domestic and international) receive minimum funding of $29,145 per year (effective May 1, 2026) for up to four years.

also.quote: International students in a full-time PhD program will be awarded an International Doctoral Student Award (IDSA)

entry_route.value: Normally a relevant thesis-based master's (or Waterloo MEng with project) with about 80%.
entry_route.quote: Normally an overall standing equivalent to 80% in either a relevant thesis-based master's degree
